question: Q-W-C1-D3
text: Compare stock group shares FY2014 vs FY2015; which group gained the most share points?
interpretation: Stock group shares FY2014 vs FY2015 and change in share points; is_top_gainer marks the largest gain (ties: name).
assemble: WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM q WHERE lines > 0 AND stock_group_name IS NOT NULL), cmp AS (SELECT a.stock_group_name, a.share AS share_fy2014, b.share AS share_fy2015, (b.share - a.share) * 100 AS change_points FROM s a JOIN s b ON b.stock_group_name = a.stock_group_name AND b.fiscal_year = 2015 WHERE a.fiscal_year = 2014), top_gainer AS (SELECT stock_group_name FROM cmp ORDER BY change_points DESC, stock_group_name LIMIT 1) SELECT c.stock_group_name, c.share_fy2014, c.share_fy2015, c.change_points, c.stock_group_name = t.stock_group_name AS is_top_gainer FROM cmp c CROSS JOIN top_gainer t ORDER BY c.stock_group_name
